audio.timing: startMs/endMs are sample positions of each cue clip in the segment (clip = speech plus 40 ms before and ~80 ms after); durationMs is the decoded length of the MP3. Measured with ffmpeg decoding, which honours the LAME gapless header (encoder delay and padding removed).

cues.text: We follow one silicon wafer through a simplified CMOS process, from bare substrate to a working inverter.
In the scanner, 193-nanometre deep ultraviolet light passes through the reticle.
The pattern is shrunk four times and projected onto the photoresist.
Nothing is etched yet. The exposed resist holds only a hidden, latent image.
